# CV-17 — Statuses, presence and Focus

> Branch `t/maciej/cv-17-statuses` · head: see the hand-back · status: built, not landed (migration waiting for its turn)
> Migration: `supabase/migrations/20261016160000_chat_v2_statuses.sql` · applied to the local stack: no (waiting for its turn; proven in rolled-back dry runs with its own test and chat_realtime / chat_notices / chat_erasure / chat_privacy / chat_foundation / chat_catchup)

## Delivered against the row

- **`user_statuses`** (one per person for every workspace: emoji ≤ 16, text ≤ 100, dnd, clear_at, preset, set_at, updated_at). Read by the person and anyone who shares a live workspace with them; written only through the ops; published. "No status" is an empty row: clearing and expiry update instead of deleting, so every change passes the read rule on its way to a listener.
- **`user_saved_statuses`** (≤ 20, private; clear_after closed list).
- **Ops** `user_op_set_status(patch)`, `user_op_clear_status()`, `user_op_save_status(patch, id)`, `user_op_forget_status(id)` (the person from the session; an API key is refused), **job** `user-statuses-expire` every 5 minutes (index on clear_at).
- **`chat_now(ws)`**: per current member, status, dnd, `focusing`, `focus_until`, `focus_task_id` + `focus_task_title` (opt-in, same workspace, visible to the caller). Members only; others, keys and signed-out callers get `[]`. Never the run.
- **Do not disturb holds pings**: `notice__gate` answers `hold` while your status has dnd on (every workspace). Pause, quiet hours and Focus are CV-18's.
- **Presence on `chat:<ws>` needs membership of a live workspace, not the plan** (CV-8a's deferral): presence keeps working while chat is paused; `chat-tab.ts` / `chat-screen.tsx` no longer turn it off when paused.
- **Erasure** counts and deletes both tables (also cascade from profiles); **export** carries your own status and saved statuses (`statuses.json`).
- **Contracts**: `STATUS_PRESETS`, `STATUS_CLEAR_AFTER` (+ parse/normalize/is), `STATUS_PRESET_DEFAULTS`, limits; drift gate on the migration's CHECKs and op lists.
- **Shapes**: `PresenceBadge` in `src/components/ui/avatar.tsx` (reachable · away · dnd · focusing · in_call · offline) with words; Presence story; token `--presence-reachable`.
- **Presence**: "Show me as online" off → the tab never tracks itself (still reads others); on → tracks `{away}`; away after 10 minutes without input; a person is away only when every tab is (`store/presence-self.ts`, `store/presence.ts`).
- **People-now store** (`src/lib/statuses/`): `chat_now` per person and workspace, live on `user_statuses` changes, re-read every minute while visible.
- **Where it shows**: DM rows (shape), DM header (status / "Focusing · until" + task), Details' People (shape + now line), person card (shape, status, Focusing with task, "won't be notified" note), the line above the box (`HoldLine`), Tasks' assign picker ("Mike · on vacation until Oct 20").
- **Status menu** from your avatar in the top bar (`src/components/app/status-menu.tsx`): current status + Clear, Active, Do not disturb (1 h · today · until…), "What's your status?" editor (emoji, words, clear after, do not disturb while it's on), Moduo's four presets, Yours (saved, forget on hover), "Save a new status…", Settings.
- **Settings → Chat → Presence**: "Show me as online", "Show what I'm focusing on".
- `READ_RPCS` += `chat_now`.

## Agent's choices (deferred to by Maciej: confirmed for building, may be reconsidered)

- **Shape precedence**: do not disturb › in a call › Focusing › reachable / away › offline; dnd and Focusing show even when the person is offline · they're server facts about whether a message pings · rejected: hiding them when offline (you'd message Jana on vacation without knowing).
- **A Pomodoro break isn't "Focusing"**, and a paused run isn't either · they're reachable then · rejected: any running run.
- **"Counted-down estimate"** = the Now task's estimate counted from when its clock started in this run (`phase_started_at + estimate_minutes`), shown only while ahead · Focus has no estimate countdown of its own · rejected: estimate minus tracked time (moves with every save).
- **`chat_now` returns only people with something to say** (a status or Focusing) · smaller; the client has the member list · rejected: every member with nulls.
- **`chat_now` and status reads need workspace membership, not the chat plan** · Tasks' picker and Home use them on any plan · rejected: the plan gate.
- **Clearing updates the row to empty** instead of deleting · keeps every live change behind the read rule · rejected: delete.
- **The app turns "clear after" into a time**; the server checks null or ahead within a year · only the app knows your midnight and week start.
- **Out sick and On vacation hold pings by default (dnd on)**; In a meeting 1 h, Commuting 30 min, Out sick today, On vacation asks for a date.
- **No activity rows for status changes** · personal, frequent, already live.
- **DM rows show the shape only** (no second line); the status itself is in the DM header, Details, the person card and the line above the box · the brief's list; NavRow has no second line · rejected: changing the primitive.
- **The avatar opens the status menu; Settings moved into it** · §15 puts status and Do not disturb on the avatar · rejected: a second avatar control. `src/components/user-menu.tsx` (unused after this) is removed.
- **The line above the box says "They"** (no pronoun data): "Jana is on vacation until Oct 20. They won't be notified; your message waits in their Catch up."
- **"In a call" is drawn** as a grey disc with a light centre dot, ready for Calls.
- **`--presence-reachable`** is a new token (dark: success green; light: a darker green) so green keeps 3:1 on light.
- **People-now re-reads every minute while visible** (Focusing can't push: runs are their person's own rows) plus on every visible status change.
- **"Show me as online" reaches other tabs** through a BroadcastChannel; a new person on the tab tracks nothing until their own switch is read.

## Gotchas (area: supabase | ui)

- supabase: `focus_runs.test.sql` fails 11 grant/publication checks on the local stack before this block too (local grants drift); not this block's.
- supabase: `pg_policies.qual` prints `auth.uid()` as `uid()`; match on `uid()`.
- ui: computed colours come back as `oklch(...)`; the visual spec converts through a 1×1 canvas before measuring contrast.
- supabase: an API key's `chat_now` call must set `request.*` claims *before* `SET LOCAL ROLE service_role` (the test schema isn't readable as service_role).

## Manual checklist (step → expect → surface)

- [ ] Click your avatar → the status menu opens with Active, Do not disturb, "What's your status?", four presets, Settings → top bar.
- [ ] Pick On vacation → asks for a date → set → your avatar shows the bar; a teammate's DM header reads "🌴 On vacation · until <date>" and the line above their box says you won't be notified.
- [ ] Teammate messages you → no device notice; the message is in your Catch up.
- [ ] Clear → teammate's views clear live.
- [ ] Save a new status "Sleeping until 6" (dnd, today) → appears under Yours → pick it → applied; hover → forget.
- [ ] Settings → Chat → Presence → turn off "Show me as online" → teammates see no shape for you within seconds, in every open tab.
- [ ] Leave Moduo idle 10 min → teammates see the grey outline; move the mouse → green again.
- [ ] Start a Pomodoro → teammates see the target and "Focusing · until <phase end>"; turn on "Show what I'm focusing on" → the task's name shows for those who can see it.
- [ ] Tasks → assign picker → "Name · on vacation until <date>".
- [ ] Pause the plan → presence shapes still show in Chat.
- [ ] Settings → Advanced → export → `statuses.json` holds your status and saved ones.
